facts.fact: A delegation of the data centre developer HiCA Data arrived in Egypt to discuss its plans for an integrated zone of giant data centres and AI, after Huawei had offered to build AI data centres with 1,408 Ascend 950 chips plus 600 more within 12 months, according to Al-Nahar.
